verdict.rationale: The evidence only glances at this story. Docs say flags can be evaluated at runtime, a community user reports easy integration with a Swift iOS app, and the repo mentions capture from websites or mobile apps. Nothing documents an official SDK lineup across backend, web and mobile, or says flags behave consistently across them. Missing for 10: documented list of official backend/web/mobile SDKs, evidence of flag evaluation in each SDK, any statement or corroboration of consistent cross-SDK flag behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use official SDKs across my whole stack — backend, web, and mobile — with consistent flag behavior

citations.quote: Evaluate flags at runtime and manage flag definitions from your own tooling and CI.
Pretty straightforward to integrate with a Swift iOS app too!
